info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates Retrieval API allows users to access and review projected utility billing estimates for specific accounts. This service is vital for consumers looking to understand potential costs associated with their utility usage. It facilitates proper budget planning by providing insights into expected billing amounts over various periods. Typical users include utility account holders, financial planners, and customer service representatives who require accurate billing information for assistance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve an estimate for billing based on the provided criteria. Users can utilize this functionality to plan their expenses accurately before committing to services.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a billing estimate. This should contain the necessary parameters for the estimation process. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled to receive a valid estimate.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for the billing estimate operations via a GET request. The expected format is a string.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the billing estimate.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result generated from the billing estimate operation.

state.description: The current state of the estimate processing.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the estimate in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the billing estimate operation.
